confidence_notes: Food/drink anchors use Tokyo-specific figures from four web searches (aggregators such as Wise, Mylifeelsewhere and Expatistan plus travel-budget guides; not official statistics, sources conflict, Numbeo's page itself was not retrieved): cheap meal ~JPY 1,000-1,200, mid-range 3-course for two ~JPY 6,400-10,000, cappuccino ~JPY 550-600, draft beer ~JPY 500-700. Cocktail (~2x beer) and wine glass (~1.5x beer) are inferred from the beer price because direct wine data was thin. Yen prices were converted at an assumed ~JPY 157/USD (not a searched rate), adding roughly +/-5% uncertainty. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July 2026 window; no accommodation searches or live listings were consulted, so they are the least certain. FX is the RBA 18 Nov 2026 rate as surfaced by an rba.gov.au-restricted search (an earlier RBA search returned only a stale March 2026 figure).
comparable_city_reasoning: Tokyo-specific price points were used for food and drink, so no substitute comparable city was needed. Accommodation reflects general knowledge of Tokyo's hostel and small-room business-hotel market, where basic hotel rooms price close to private hostel rooms and inbound-tourism demand is high.
